info.name: HCMS API
info.description: Generated from src/docs/openapi.json by scripts/buildPostmanCollection.js (npm run docs:build). Import with HCMS.postman_environment.json, run '0. Sign in', then any request. Path ids such as {{alertId}} are environment variables; set them to real ids from your data.

item.name: 0. Sign in
item.description: Run these first. Each saves its role token and also sets {{token}} for the shared folder.

request.description:
Creates an Emergency Alert for a visitor without requiring authentication. The visitor's phone is required; patient_id remains null, priority is HIGH, and initial status is PENDING_ASSIGNMENT.

operationId: createPublicEmergencyAlert

item.name: Activate or deactivate a user account (FR-10.1)

request.description:
SUSPENDED deactivates an ACTIVE account and ACTIVE re-activates a SUSPENDED one. Applicants (INACTIVE) are activated through Join Requests only. An Administrator cannot change their own account or deactivate the last active Administrator. The change applies from the user's next request and is recorded in the Activity Log as ACTIVATE_USER or DEACTIVATE_USER.


operationId: updateUserAccountStatus

Returns all pending Doctor and NGO Join Requests. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account.


operationId: listPendingJoinRequests

Returns a single Doctor or NGO Join Request by ID. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account.


operationId: getJoinRequest

Approves a pending Doctor or NGO Join Request and activates the associated user account. The request must still be PENDING and its user data must be consistent with the request type. No request body fields are accepted. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account.


operationId: approveJoinRequest

Rejects a pending Doctor or NGO Join Request. A non-empty rejection_reason is required and may contain up to 500 characters. The request must still be PENDING and its user data must be consistent with the request type. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account.


operationId: rejectJoinRequest

request.description:
Returns all Emergency Alerts ordered by sent_at descending, then by ID descending. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account. Paging is optional: without page or limit the full list is returned; with either, 20 per page by default and page metadata next to the list.


operationId: listEmergencyAlertsForAdmin

Returns a single Emergency Alert by ID. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account.


operationId: getEmergencyAlertForAdmin

Assigns an eligible active Doctor to an Emergency Alert that is currently PENDING_ASSIGNMENT. Eligible Doctor specializations are General Medicine and Emergency Medicine. On success, the Emergency Alert status becomes ASSIGNED. The assignment also records the assigning Admin and assignment time. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account.


operationId: assignDoctorToEmergencyAlert

query.description: Items per page (at most 100). The default depends on the endpoint.

request.description:
Returns all Doctor-Patient assignments ordered by assigned_at descending, then by ID descending. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account. Paging is optional: without page or limit the full list is returned; with either, 20 per page by default and page metadata next to the list.


operationId: listDoctorPatientAssignments

Creates an ACTIVE assignment between an existing active Doctor and an existing active Patient. Only one ACTIVE assignment may exist for the same Doctor-Patient pair. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account.


operationId: createDoctorPatientAssignment

Returns a single Doctor-Patient assignment by ID. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account.


operationId: getDoctorPatientAssignment

Updates an assignment status to ACTIVE or INACTIVE. Setting the status to INACTIVE records ended_at. Setting it to ACTIVE clears ended_at, provided another ACTIVE assignment does not already exist for the same Doctor-Patient pair. Reactivation also requires ACTIVE Doctor and Patient accounts, an available Doctor, assignable Patient intake, and a non-empty internal assignment_reason. Requires an ACTIVE ADMIN account.


operationId: updateDoctorPatientAssignmentStatus

request.description: operationId: listAssignedPatientTreatmentPlans

Creates a plan for a Patient with an ACTIVE assignment to the authenticated Doctor. start_date and end_date are calendar dates in YYYY-MM-DD format; if end_date is supplied it must be on or after start_date.

operationId: createAssignedPatientTreatmentPlan

Returns a Treatment Plan for the Patient only when the authenticated Doctor has an ACTIVE assignment.

operationId: getAssignedPatientTreatmentPlan

Requires an ACTIVE assignment and at least one editable field. If the resulting end_date is set, it must be on or after the resulting start_date. The resulting inclusive range must contain every existing appointment; an update that excludes one is rejected without changing the plan.

operationId: updateAssignedPatientTreatmentPlan
operationId: listTreatmentMedications

Adds a medication to an authorized Treatment Plan. Doctor access requires an ACTIVE assignment to the Patient.

operationId: createTreatmentMedication
operationId: getTreatmentMedication

Updates one or more supplied fields on a medication belonging to the authorized plan. An empty update is rejected.

operationId: updateTreatmentMedication

Deletes a medication belonging to the authorized Treatment Plan and returns the deleted record.

operationId: deleteTreatmentMedication
operationId: listTreatmentAppointments

Creates an appointment under an authorized Treatment Plan. appointment_date is a Palestinian local wall-clock time in Asia/Hebron, supplied as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss without a timezone suffix; its calendar date must fall within the plan's inclusive start_date/end_date range (when an end date exists).

operationId: createTreatmentAppointment
operationId: getTreatmentAppointment

Requires at least one editable field. appointment_date uses the Asia/Hebron local wall-clock YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format without a timezone suffix. If changed, its calendar date must remain within the plan's inclusive date range.

operationId: updateTreatmentAppointment

Deletes an appointment belonging to the authorized Treatment Plan and returns the deleted record.

operationId: deleteTreatmentAppointment

Creates an allocation for a request assigned to this NGO. Creation is allowed only while request status is APPROVED; quantity must be a positive integer.

Returns the authenticated user's profile. The returned profile shape depends on whether the current user is a Patient, Doctor, NGO, or Admin.


operationId: getOwnProfile

Updates approved self-service profile fields. Patients may update full_name, phone, date_of_birth, gender, and address. Doctors may update only full_name and phone. NGO and Admin accounts cannot use this endpoint.


operationId: updateOwnProfile

Changes the signed-in user's password after checking the current one. Any active role may call it. The new password follows the registration policy (at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit, at most 72 UTF-8 bytes) and must differ from the current one. A wrong current password returns 400 with a field error, not 401. Only failed attempts count toward the rate limit (5 per 15 minutes by default). Recorded in the activity log as CHANGE_PASSWORD. Tokens issued before the change stay valid until they expire.


operationId: changeOwnPassword

query.description: Items per page (at most 100). The default depends on the endpoint.

request.description:
Returns notifications belonging only to the authenticated user, newest first. Any active authenticated role may call this endpoint. The list is paged, 50 per page by default (`limit` up to 100), with page, limit, total and total_pages next to it.

operationId: listOwnNotifications

Returns the authenticated user's unread notification count. Any active authenticated role may call this endpoint.

operationId: getUnreadNotificationCount

item.name: Mark all own Notifications as read

request.description:
Marks all unread notifications belonging to the authenticated user as read and returns the number of rows updated. Requires an empty JSON object body; no role restriction is applied.

operationId: markAllOwnNotificationsRead

Marks a notification belonging to the authenticated user as read. Repeating the operation is idempotent. Requires an empty JSON object body; no role restriction is applied.

operationId: markOwnNotificationRead

Sends a message between one Patient and one Doctor. The pair must have an ACTIVE Doctor-Patient Assignment. Message text is trimmed and limited to 65535 UTF-8 bytes; client sender IDs and read fields are not accepted.

operationId: sendMessage

Returns one summary per conversation involving the authenticated user, newest message first. No conversation is returned until at least one message exists.

operationId: listConversations

query.description: Items per page (at most 100). The default depends on the endpoint.

request.description:
Returns messages exchanged between the authenticated user and the specified Patient or Doctor, ordered oldest first. Existing conversation history is required; the ACTIVE assignment requirement governs new messages. Paged from the newest messages, so page 1 holds the newest 100 by default (`limit` up to 100), and each page is returned oldest first. A page past the end is an empty list.

operationId: getConversationHistory

Only the message receiver may mark it as read. Repeating the operation for an already-read message succeeds and returns its current record. The request body must be an empty JSON object.

operationId: markMessageRead

Returns the currently authenticated user's public account information. Requires a valid JWT access token and an ACTIVE account.


operationId: getCurrentUser
